comments: NOT the final version -- a shortened (150 vs the original 300 epochs) native-resolution (124x2048) pretraining pass for the kernel3+dropout architecture (bottleneck_kernel_size=3, dropout_rate=0.1), trained from random init on the full-resolution dataset. Purpose: give kurals_8x64_kernel3_finetune_dropout's initialization a real pretrained starting point for bott_c/d1/d2's depthwise weights, instead of the random init those 3 layers currently get from kurals/expand_kernel3.py's partial transfer (since the original native checkpoint used bottleneck_kernel_size=5, kernel3's dw conv weights have no matching-shape source to copy). 150 epochs covers quant_warmup_iters (~epoch 44) with substantial post-warmup QAT-active training, short of quant_freeze_iters (~epoch 174) -- the downstream 8x64 finetune run completes its own full warmup/freeze cycle regardless, so this checkpoint doesn't need to reach its own freeze point, just reasonably-trained weights everywhere. Compare against kernel3+finetune+dropout's existing 0.3757/0.3635 (partial-transfer init) once finetuned from this checkpoint instead.
